title: I Survived a Crime
description:
S01 E03
A family faces off with violent attackers trying to rob its jewelry store; two young women flee from a driver who is out to get them on a terrifying road trip; convenience and crime collide at a bank ATM.

title: I Survived a Crime
description:
S02 E03
A driver fires his gun wildly during a road rage incident; two men are assaulted by an angry sheriff and his brother while ordering food; a soccer referee is tackled by a parent.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E16 — Blue Bonnet Bandit
A look at some of the arrests from across the country; a man arrested at sea tries to swim away from police; a man wearing a blue bonnet steals baby formula; a mom goes to extreme measures with a housemate and is arrested for assault.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E17 — Push-Up Rage
A hyped-up man goes toe to toe with police; a woman flips off fellow drivers while dancing in the street; a pilot is arrested for allegedly stealing a plane; and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E18 — Naked Chaos
A boater goes off the deep end; a naked man causes traffic chaos; a police uniform-swiper gets taken to the cleaners; and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E19 — Mr. Funk's Wild Ride
A man calls 911 on the cops; a woman is accused of stealing a horse and buggy; a man allegedly trespasses and shoots rats in a neighbor's yard.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E20 — Sweet Tea Pleasure
A suspect crashes into a jail; a woman has fun at the movies; a vandal wreaks havoc at a winery.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E21 — Top 5: Intoxicating Moments
A look at some strange moments of intoxicated arrestees from across the country; a man is arrested for drunk driving a lawnmower; a friend joins her bestie in jail after a DUI.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E22 — Top 5: Bare Naked Moments
A naked woman is arrested for stealing a sheriff's pickup truck; a gym goer loses his cool and his clothing; and a golf pro spectator streaks into the spotlight.

title: I Survived a Crime
description:
S02 E02

title: Elizabeth Smart: Finding Justice
description:
S01 E01 — The Brainwashed Bride: The Candra Torres Case
Chandra Torres sits down with fellow kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart to discuss life in captivity at the hands of a master manipulator and murderer.

title: Elizabeth Smart: Autobiography
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
Kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart, family members and law-enforcement officials discuss the 2002 abduction that made national headlines and the efforts made to find and save her.

title: Elizabeth Smart: Autobiography
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
Kidnapping victim Elizabeth Smart tells the story of traveling to Southern California with her abductors, their return to Utah, and how the television show "America's Most Wanted" played a role in her rescue.

title: Jodi Arias: Cellmate Secrets
description: New information comes to light about Jodi Arias and the murder of her ex-boyfriend, Travis Alexander, as her former cellmates and closest confidants give firsthand accounts of their time behind bars with the murderess.

title: Jonestown: The Women Behind the Massacre
description: Four women belonging to cult leader Jim Jones' inner circle help plan the 1978 Jonestown massacre in Guyana, which leaves more than 900 people dead.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E01 — The Voice in the Lake
When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E03 — Horror in the Dark
Teens Lianna Adank and Eric Goldstrand are found shot to death at an Oregon park in 1977; detectives doggedly pursue leads for 40 years until a single piece of evidence leads them to a suspect three states away.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E04 — Justice for Mary
When Mary Scott, 23, is found murdered in her San Diego home in 1969, the case quickly loses steam with few leads; years later, Mary's daughters grow determined to find answers about the mother they barely knew, and a crime that's 50 years cold.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E06 — A Deadly Premonition
When 31-year-old Linda Slaten is brutally strangled in her Lakeland, Fla., home in 1981, a complex web of suspects emerges; the case takes a dramatic turn when a DNA hit exposes the sinister underbelly of a seemingly peaceful community.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E08 — Deadly Web of Lies
When gambler Scott Martinez, 47, is found eviscerated by a sword in his La Mesa, Calif., home, investigators can't tell who is telling the truth within his inner circle; it takes 13 years and an advance in DNA analysis to find his killer.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E09 — Death Downstream
When the battered body of Shawna Yandell, 16, is found floating in Washington State's Yakima River, detectives first suspect those closest to her; the case grew cold until new DNA technology revealed a callous killer that no one suspected.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E10 — Death of a Yellow Rose
When Susan Woods, 30, is found beaten and drowned in her tub in America's cowboy capital, suspicion falls on her estranged husband; with a suspect's DNA in hand, detectives go back to the basics to unmask a killer cowboy living in plain sight.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S03 E08 — Anthony Todt
After the brutal murder of a mom, her children, and the family dog rocks a picture-perfect Orlando suburb - all signs point to the dad, Tony Todt; Tony's own tear-soaked and unpredictable testimony points to someone else.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S03 E09 — Dean Cummings
Skiing icon Dean Cummings is on trial for the shooting death of Guillermo Arriola, a local New Mexican rancher who was only armed with a can of mace; Cummings claims the shooting was done in self-defense.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S03 E10 — Cindy Schulz
In 2006, Ken Juedes was found dead by his wife, Cindy Schulz-Juedes.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S03 E11 — Andrew Mitchell
During a routine undercover prostitution sting, Columbus Vice Detective Andrew Mitchell shoots and kills 23-year-old Donna Dalton Castleberry; Mitchell claims he feared for his life, but the prosecution argues that Donna was no longer a threat.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S03 E12 — Andre McDonald
Air Force Maj. Andre McDonald is on trial for the murder of his wife, San Antonio businesswoman Andreen McDonald, and takes the stand to claim he is the victim of a domestic dispute gone wrong.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E06 — Sasha Skare
Sasha Skare, 23, is on trial for the murder of her lover Martell DeRouen and has turned down a plea deal; she decides to take the stand to tell her side of the story, saying she was abused, and the shooting was unintentional.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E09 — Steve Pankey
After 35 years of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews' disappearance from her home in Greeley, CO, her remains are recovered; investigators charge former Idaho Gubernatorial candidate Steve Pankey with murder; Pankey takes the stand.
